card.name: Start of web address after www
card.fires_on: The dot plus first letter(s) right after "www" in a web address, mostly where the site name starts with s or c. It appears in contact or further-information lines.

modes.label: Dot and s after www
modes.description: The ".s" that begins a site name starting with s.

modes.label: Dot and c after www
modes.description: The ".c" that begins a site name such as cdc.gov.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a website name right after www, in lines pointing readers to more information.
